title: Light and Shadows
summary: Luminous objects, transparent, translucent and opaque materials, shadows and the pinhole camera.

cbse.chapter: Curiosity Ch 11: Light: Shadows and Reflections

objectives: I can classify objects as luminous or non-luminous, and materials as transparent, translucent or opaque.
I can explain how shadows form, and why their size changes, using the idea that light travels in straight lines.
I can explain why a pinhole camera gives an upside-down image.
misconceptions: We see because light comes out of our eyes.
A shadow shows the colour of the object.
The Moon is a luminous object.
